title: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Role-Playing Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2611.07469v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon role-playing dialogue requires consistent character identity, reliable memory, and context-sensitive interaction. We present a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework that revises original-character memory, stable persona instructions, and a policy for constructing turn-level prompts. Repair outcomes also inform revisions to the updater's diagnostic rules, edit routing, and candidate selection. We specify the updater as a versioned policy with explicit inputs, editable fields, acceptance gates, and stopping conditions. An internal evaluation covers 50 original characters and five models, with two 100-round conversations per character-model pair: 500 conversations per condition. Across the pooled evaluated replies, the bad-response rate decreases from 14.00% (6,973/49,824) to 4.94% (2,459/49,793), a 9.06-percentage-point reduction and a 64.71% relative reduction. translated_title: 面向长程角色扮演对话的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 长程角色扮演对话需要一致的角色身份、可靠的记忆以及语境敏感的交互。我们提出了一种有界递归自我改进框架，用于修订原创角色的记忆、稳定的人设指令以及构建回合级提示词的策略。修复结果还会进一步用于修订更新器的诊断规则、编辑路由和候选选择。我们将更新器定义为一个带版本管理的策略，具有显式输入、可编辑字段、验收门限和停止条件。内部评估涵盖50个原创角色和五个模型，每个角色-模型对进行两段100轮对话：每个条件下共500段对话。在汇总的评估回复中，劣质回复率从14.00%（6,973/49,824）降至4.94%（2,459/49,793），绝对下降9.06个百分点，相对下降64.71%。在600次盲测人工对比中，RSI获得294次……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种有界递归自我改进（RSI）框架，通过自我修订角色记忆、人设指令与回合级提示策略，将长程角色扮演对话的劣质回复率从14.00%降至4.94%（相对降低64.71%）。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a bounded recursive self-improvement (RSI) framework that iteratively revises character memory, persona instructions, and turn-level prompt policies, reducing the bad-response rate in long-horizon role-playing dialogue from 14.00% to 4.94% (a 64.71% relative reduction).
